data_fields.name: zoneForceLeaveTrack
data_fields.donor_constant: ForceSetLeaveMusicId; -1 or nil means off, positive overrides OutMusic

best_idea: Pick the music track from the zone transition (the leave track of the zone being left wins, else the entry track of the new zone), and save and restore the current track around a battle so the zone line and the fight each set the right music without the zone knowing about battles.
decision_why: Zones are data, so the leave/entry track pair belongs in zone data, and the save/restore keeps the Pit client simple; adapt because the donor cuts instantly, has no crossfade and no voice cap.
acceptance: Crossing a zone line plays the leave track of the zone left (or the new zone's entry track if none), and after a fight the previous zone track resumes without restarting (a client test asserts the current track id equals the saved id).
